newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia debt reconciliation to take 2-3 mths more.
newsitem.headline: Russia debt reconciliation to take 2-3 mths more.

text.p: A board member of Deutsche Bank AG said on Friday the final reconciliation of Russia's external debt to commercial bank creditors, the London Club, would take another two or three months.

"The process is running now at high speed. It will take a little more time. We hope that it can be completed in the next 2-3 months," management board member Georg Krupp told a Moscow news conference.
Reconciliation is the final stage in rescheduling Russia's commercial bank debt, involving checks on all loans included in the agreement.

Krupp said the process was taking longer than expected because it was an enormous amount of work to process the 30,000 individual loans involved. Many of the loans are traded on the secondary market. --Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
